violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED PRIOR TO THE END OF THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: cooked boba held from 11am-3pm.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EMPLOYEE ADDED TIME STICKER.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: No certified food manager was on site at start of inspection. It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: CFM arrived towards end of inspection. Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: tapioca pearls observed at 95F in crock pot.
violations.corrective_action: Boba will be placed on time as it can’t be held at 135F. Boba was made at 11am and will be discarded at 3pm. Owner was instructed to create TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL procedures and to mark the boba the time when prepared and the time of discard which is to be no more than 4hrs. Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: small mixer/blender in rear kitchen and the crockpot.
violations.corrective_action: All equipment must be NSF or equivalent. Please provide a crockpot and mixer/blender that meets this certification requirement. Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions.
